purpose: Compact, sanitized measurements from the local image-generation comparison probe (tools/probes/art-local-2). Derived from the probe's results.json files and server logs; raw logs, crash reports, images and local paths are not included. Measurements only: no quality, canon, redistribution or acceptance claim.

host.note: The harness records metalVerified=false by design; Metal initialisation is evidenced by the server log lines.

componentVerification: All runtime and component bytes were re-hashed against components.json (size and SHA-256) before the matrix: every component matched, none missing or mismatched, except the Z-Image LoRA noted under arms.

units.wallAndTimings: milliseconds per generation (Ms) or seconds where named
units.residentSampledKiB: KiB, sampled once per second from the process tree via ps; a lower bound, not a guaranteed maximum
units.diskAvailableGiB: GiB of free disk from df -k (not memory)
units.memoryFreePercent: memory_pressure -Q system-wide free percentage (not disk, not RSS)
units.monitorCadence: about 10 s; separate from the 1 s RSS sampling

fullMatrix.definition: Per arm: cells 512x640 and 768x768, each with 1 warmup and 3 samples, with-LoRA and same-seed no-LoRA control, plus a restart-based cancellation probe. n=3 samples per cell variant, so p95 equals the sample maximum under the nearest-rank rule.

prompts.note: Same subject and negative prompt across arms. SDXL and Z-Image use 'pixel art, a bearded Greek god in a white toga holding a lightning bolt, ...'; FLUX uses 'A pixel art spritesheet of a bearded Greek god in a white toga holding a lightning bolt, ...' (as the spritesheet LoRA expects). Exact prompts are in arms/*.json.
prompts.negativePrompt: blurry, antialiased, smooth gradients, photograph, 3d render, text, watermark

imageAccounting.breakdown: nolora 8 (2 warmup + 6 samples), SDXL 16 (4 + 12), FLUX 16 (4 + 12); repeats within a cell are byte-identical so unique images are 2 + 4 + 4; the Z-Image LoRA arm produced none. 40 files, not 56.
imageAccounting.interruptedFluxAttempt: A first FLUX run was killed by a tool timeout (not by the harness) after 4 with-LoRA 512x640 images; it has no results.json or logs and is excluded here. FLUX was rerun once from the start and only the rerun is recorded.

sdxlDefaultLoraApplyMode.description: First SDXL smoke (n=1, 512x640): control completed; the with-LoRA cell failed.

lora.reason: sample 0 failed: request failed: Unable to connect. Is the computer able to access the url? (server not reachable or timed out)

sdxlDefaultLoraApplyMode.observed: The server aborted (SIGABRT) while applying the LoRA during the first sampling step; the backtrace passes through LoraModel::apply -> ggml_backend_sched_reserve_size -> ggml_abort. The abort message text was not captured (the log tail was 4,000 characters). Default --lora-apply-mode is auto, which the server documents as 'immediately' for non-quantised weights.

sdxlLoraApplyModeAtRuntime.description: Same SDXL smoke with --lora-apply-mode at_runtime added (n=1, 512x640).
sdxlLoraApplyModeAtRuntime.conclusion: Both cells completed; the flag is a measured workaround, not a root-cause fix. It is set in the SDXL arm configs.

sdxlExplicitVaeTiling768.description: Single 768x768 pair with --vae-tiling and --lora-apply-mode at_runtime added (n=1, no warmup). A separate experiment; it does not replace the n=3 full-matrix cells.

sdxl768WithLoraMetalMemoryShortfall.evidence: In the full-matrix server log, each of the four 768x768 with-LoRA generations (warmup + 3 samples) logged a VAE decode memory warning group and recovered by automatic spatial tiling.
sdxl768WithLoraMetalMemoryShortfall.autoRecovery: Reducing VAE decode tiles from 768x768 to 256x256 image pixels; VAE decode ran out of memory; retrying with spatial tiling.
sdxl768WithLoraMetalMemoryShortfall.affectedCell: 768x768:lora, warmup and samples 0-2 (all four still produced valid PNGs)
caveats: The 8 ERROR lines (4 repeated pairs: 'vae segment 1/1 (graph) failed during weight preparation' / 'vae decode compute failed') are in the stderr section; the harness stores stdout then stderr, so their position relative to the warnings is not recorded. That they are the failed first decode attempts is a hypothesis fitting the counts and messages, not proven.

The 768x768 control decodes ran untiled while the with-LoRA decodes ran tiled, so the 768x768 with-LoRA vs control comparison is confounded by decode path. The explicit-tiling experiment shows different pixels for both variants against the full matrix; why the automatic and explicit tiled with-LoRA outputs also differ is unknown.
The 42 MB figure is a Metal device-memory shortfall inside the server, not system free memory.

candidates.note: p95 104.87 s at n=3. 768x768 with-LoRA p95 is 203.35 s and carries the tiled-decode caveat above.

targetSizeReview.kind: static derivation from existing full-matrix sample 0 outputs; no new generation, no model run

method.transform: Independent integer-axis reduction by center sampling: destination coordinate d on an axis with scale s samples source floor((d + 0.5) * s). Factor 8 on both axes (source offset +4). No crop, aspect change, normalization, palette change, background removal or generic resize.
method.inputPng: 8-bit non-interlaced RGB (color type 2), opaque; tEXt chunk present on every source
method.outputPng: 8-bit RGBA (color type 6), alpha 255; tEXt and profile chunks not preserved

targetSizeReview.storage: Paths are relative to tools/probes/art-local-2. Everything under results/ is gitignored: the derivatives, review sheets, manifest and helper scripts are local and not durable.
